textbookText: Study Notes — Offline Study Platform A fully offline, framework-free study website, currently scoped to Class 11: 6 subjects → chapters → topics → notes/examples/practice/formulas/summary (plus 8 extra revision sections — special notes, important statements, important notes, exam short tricks, exam notes, MCQs, important concepts, important tasks). Search, dark mode, collapsible sidebar, breadcrumbs, back-to-top — all built with plain HTML, CSS, and JavaScript. No internet, no build step, no server required.

The "Class 11" label is set once, in js/app.js ( CLASS_LABEL ), and shows up in the sidebar, breadcrumbs, and search results. It's a label only — subjects/chapters/topics aren't stored per-class yet, so if a second class is ever added later, that constant is the seam to turn into real per-class data.
